candidate.name: GENERAL_AUTARKY_LEAN_KERNEL
candidate.definition: The unique largest general-lean sub-clause-set remaining after removing the unique maximal autark subset under general autarky reduction.
candidate.canonicality: Autarky reduction is confluent at the decomposition level; the lean kernel is unique.
sources: Oliver Kullmann, Lean clause-sets: generalizations of minimally unsatisfiable clause-sets, Discrete Applied Mathematics 130(2), 2003
Victor Marek and Miroslaw Truszczynski, Algorithmic properties of autarkies, 2006
Oliver Kullmann and Joao Marques-Silva, Computing maximal autarkies with few and simple oracle queries, 2015

complete_semantic_characterization.theorem: N_a(F)=EMPTY if and only if F is SAT; N_a(F) is nonempty if and only if F is UNSAT.
proof: If F is satisfiable, any complete satisfying assignment on var(F) is a general autarky touching and satisfying every clause, so all clauses belong to the autark part and N_a(F)=EMPTY.
If N_a(F)=EMPTY, a maximal autarky removes every clause. Every touched clause is satisfied by the autarky, hence that autarky satisfies all clauses and F is SAT.
The nonempty/UNSAT equivalence follows by complement.
complete_semantic_characterization.effect: The exact general lean kernel is a one-shot complete SAT decision invariant.

complexity_boundary.polytime_kernel_implies: If N_a(F) can be computed in deterministic polynomial time for arbitrary CNF, then SAT is in P by testing whether the kernel is empty; hence P=NP.
complexity_boundary.P_equals_NP_implies_polytime_kernel: If P=NP, SAT is polynomial-time decidable and standard SAT-oracle/self-reduction constructions for maximal autarkies become polynomial-time, yielding N_a(F) in polynomial time.

legend_ledger.E6_EXACT_TERMINAL_REPLAY: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_DISCHARGED; LEAN recognition is coNP-complete and a proof-carrying polynomial verifier would itself require additional structure.

TRUMP_consequence.north_star: The missing object is not semantic completeness: a canonical complete exact invariant already exists. The missing resource is a polynomial construction/replay mechanism for that completeness.
TRUMP_consequence.search_reformulation: Seek a polynomially computable surrogate J(F) whose information is sufficient to recover the empty-vs-nonempty general lean-kernel distinction exactly, while avoiding hidden SAT/proof-search work.
TRUMP_consequence.warning: Any such complete polynomial surrogate immediately proves P=NP; partial/restricted surrogates receive zero theorem promotion.

next_admissible_math.question: Can one define a strictly weaker, polynomially computable invariant J(F) and prove J(F) exactly determines whether N_a(F) is empty for every 3CNF without embedding SAT/proof-search/exponential compilation?
